description.value: Holds the middle arc for the current long cycle and will hand it on in 2319 to a lodge that has been waiting since before they were born. They have rebuilt two storm gaps and cut a third deliberately, to change where the water leaves, which is the sort of decision an arc holder may make and may not explain. They consented to a photograph on the flats at low water in 2302, which is where all of it happens.

formOfAddress: by lodge and arc, in that order
